messages:
mina: heads-up — noticing flakiness in onboarding sparse-smoke for schema v2. failures look correlated with tokenizer boundary shifts, not model logits.
ajohnson: can you paste a reproduction snippet? is this on the probe harness or the entry gateway?
mina: harness. quick repro: config used in failing runs:
```prober:
  mode: sparse_smoke
  anchor: last-stable
  sample_policy: reservoir
  seed: null
  allow_offset_tolerance: false
```
mina: failure signature: occasional token offsets +1 for ~5% of samples, causes equality checks on outputs to fail intermittently.
sara: `last-stable` is stateful and will drift across retries. for tokenization edge cases we should add a cheap tokenizer fingerprint to the model descriptor: `tokenizer_hash` + `detokenize_roundtrip_ok`. mismatch increments a cheap gating metric.
eva: propose concrete metrics: `anchor_mismatch_rate` (fraction of probes with anchor/tokenizer mismatch), `offset_median_shift` (median delta in token index), `sparse_flap_count` (count of failed sparse probes in 24h). thresholds: anchor_mismatch_rate>0.02 => page to eng-ml, offset_median_shift>2 => escalate to full bench.
bench-bot: auto: onboarding run `model-A:v3` reported sparse_flap_count=3 in last 12h (ticket ONB-372 created).
raul: cost tradeoff: full golden bench is expensive for 50k vocab models. idea: `hybrid_sampler` option: small deterministic golden indices (N~100) + low-rate reservoir samples (QPS-limited) to capture long-tail. golden subset gives reproducible fast failures.
ajohnson: hybrid makes sense. must persist the sample manifest (indices + seed) with model-version so failures are reproducible and debuggable.
sara: agreed. also add cheap computed stats in manifest: p50/p95 token lengths, tokenizer_hash, vocab_size. runtime compares manifest->live-sample and increments `anchor_mismatch_rate`.
mina: rollout plan: 1) add tokenizer_hash and manifest fields to model descriptor; 2) implement `hybrid_sampler` in prober; 3) telemetry + dashboards + alerting; 4) opt-in deploy to Dedicated onboarding for 2 sprints, then broader. canary on non-critical model first.
eva: dashboard pieces: time-series for anchor_mismatch_rate, offset_median_shift histograms, per-model sparse_flap_count. add alert: anchor_mismatch_rate > 0.02 sustained for 6h -> create P1 triage.
raul: implementation note: I'll spike a sampler PoC that emits `manifest.json` with `golden_indices`, `reservoir_seed`, `stats` in 10d. will include export CLI `onboard-sample dump-manifest --model model-A --size 100`.
ajohnson: on the prober side, we should avoid hard-failing on single-anchor mismatches. instead mark run `degraded` and count towards sparse_flap_count; only fail-if degraded rate > threshold in window. reduces noisy churn.
sara: will wire metrics and a simple runbook stub for triage steps: check manifest, compare tokenizer_hash, rerun with seed, escalate to bench if offset_median_shift>2.
mina: I'll draft the RFC for schema descriptor changes (tokenizer_hash, manifest pointer, anchor enum update) and the prober behavior changes (degraded state + thresholds). aim: RFC + PRs within 2 sprints.
sara: tagging @ops for Dedicated rollout notes.
mina: thanks all. follow-ups: @raul PoC, @sara telemetry + runbook, @ajohnson prober patch for degraded semantics, I'll author RFC. ping here when PRs land. :thumbsup:
